data.body: Review run 1 BLOCKED (9 findings; full log in session scratch). The blocks rested on 3 facts: (a) on Windows _pid_alive always answers alive, (b) _sweep_exited's os.WNOHANG raises AttributeError there, and (c) stop_local_sweep accepts 'unverified-live', so a leftover stamp can make it TerminateProcess a recycled pid. smoking-bereft-boar fixes (a) and (b), so this ticket now depends on it. This plan closes (c): stop_local_sweep never signals off POSIX. It also covers the advisories: the no-op wording in docs/config.md and docs/concurrency.md, and a real Windows detached-spawn test. AC block unchanged. Re-review waits for boar to close.
